using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using CobolCS.Runtime;

namespace CobolCS.Generated;

/// <summary>同じ業務 JSON を、内部 snapshot のない業務サービスへ接続します。</summary>
public sealed class PaymentAdapter : IBusinessCaseAdapter
{
    /// <summary>Gets 期待値を維持する業務契約の版。</summary>
    public string ContractId => "payment-v1";

    /// <summary>生成 Executor と内部変数に依存しないサービスを呼びます。</summary>
    /// <param name="input">正式残高と独立した固定応答。</param>
    /// <returns>サービスの安定した業務結果。</returns>
    public BusinessObservation Execute(BusinessCaseInput input)
    {
        var fee = RefactoredPaymentService.CalculateFee(Number.Parse(input.Values["balance"]!.GetValue<string>()));
        var response = input.External.Invoke(
            "customer.lookup",
            new JsonObject { ["code"] = "  " },
            request => request,
            reply => reply);
        return new BusinessObservation(
            new JsonObject { ["fee"] = fee.Decimal(2), ["errorCode"] = response["code"]!.GetValue<string>() },
            input.External.Effects,
            "returned");
    }
}
